title: Act 1 of 2014 - 2015 Appropriation Act 2014
text:
2015 Appropriation—1 of 2014 1
ACT NO. 1 OF 2014
I assent.
E. NAILATIKAU
President
[15 December 2014]
AN ACT
TO APPROPRIATE A SUM OF THREE BILLION, TWENTY FIVE MILLION, SIX
THOUSAND, AND FIVE HUNDRED DOLLARS FOR THE ORDINARY
SERVICES OF GOVERNMENT FOR THE YEAR ENDING 31st DECEMBER,
2015
ENACTED by the Parliament of the Republic of Fiji—
Short title and commencement
1. This Act may be cited as the 2015 Appropriation Act 2014, and shall come into
force on 1st January, 2015.
Appropriation of $3,025,006,500
2. A sum of $3,025,006,500 is to be issued from the Consolidated Fund or other funds
of the State, and applied to the ordinary services of the Government for the year ending
31st December, 2015, and such sum is to be appropriated for the purposes specified in
Schedules 1 and 2 and also the 2015 Budget Estimates.
Government Borrowing
3.—(1) The Government borrowing for 2015 shall not exceed the sum of $363,521,994.

2 2015 Appropriation—1 of 2014
(2) For the purpose of subsection (1), the Minister for Finance may, subject to the
approval of Parliament, borrow on behalf of the State by raising loans not exceeding
$363,521,994 in 2015 for the following purposes—
(a) meeting loan repayments for loans raised prior to 2015 and falling due for
redemption in part or in whole in 2015;
(b) conversion of maturing loans;
(c) conversion of outstanding treasury bills into loans; and
(d) funding the costs of any expenditure for loans implementation purposes in
2015
